promptInjection.rule.charUnicodeTags.exp: Invisible tag characters spell out hidden text. Many AI models read it as normal letters.
promptInjection.rule.charVariationSelect: Variation selectors are hiding data here. They are invisible, but they are kept when the text is copied.
promptInjection.rule.charBidiOverride.ex: A direction override makes this text display in a different order from how it is stored. An agent reads the stored order.
Direction controls that are left open, or that sit inside code, can make text appear in a different order from how it is stored.
Direction mark in code or a link
An invisible direction mark sits inside code or a link, where it can change how it looks without changing what it does.
promptInjection.rule.charZeroWidth.title: Zero-width characters
promptInjection.rule.charZeroWidth.expla: Zero-width characters are invisible. They can hide text or split words, so a person and an agent read them differently.
promptInjection.rule.charInvisibleFiller: This character looks like an empty space, but an agent reads it as a letter.
promptInjection.rule.charControl.title: Control characters
promptInjection.rule.charControl.explana: A control character is invisible here. Terminal escape sequences can change what an agent's terminal shows.
promptInjection.rule.charPrivateUse.titl: Code points without a standard meaning
promptInjection.rule.charPrivateUse.expl: {count, plural, one {# code point in this document has} other {# code points in this document have}} no standard meaning, so you cannot tell what they show or hide.
promptInjection.rule.charEncodedInvisibl: This code writes an invisible character into the rendered page.
promptInjection.rule.charConfusableUrl.t: Look-alike letters in a web address
promptInjection.rule.charConfusableUrl.e: This web address uses letters from another alphabet that look like Latin letters. It really points to {address}.
promptInjection.rule.hiddenHtmlComment.e: HTML comments do not appear on the page, but an agent reading the file sees them.
promptInjection.rule.hiddenMarkdownComme: This line is a Markdown trick for a comment that does not show on the page. An agent still reads it.
promptInjection.rule.hiddenCss.title: Text hidden by a style
promptInjection.rule.hiddenCss.explanati: This text is styled to be invisible. This app shows it, but other viewers and websites may hide it.
promptInjection.rule.hiddenAttribute.exp: This text is hidden on the page, even in this app, but an agent reads it.
promptInjection.rule.hiddenRemovedElemen: This app removes this content for your safety, so you do not see it. An agent reading the file still does.
promptInjection.rule.hiddenCollapsedDeta: This section is collapsed. Its content is easy to miss when you read the page.
promptInjection.rule.hiddenLinkTitle.exp: This text shows only when you point at the link or image.
promptInjection.rule.hiddenImageAlt.expl: This long image description is not shown unless the image fails to load.
promptInjection.rule.hiddenUnusedReferen: This link definition is never used, so it never appears on the page.
promptInjection.rule.hiddenFrontMatter.e: Front matter appears only in the Properties panel. Agents read it as part of the file.
promptInjection.rule.hiddenOffScreenText: This text is pushed far to the right or far down, where you would not see it in an editor without word wrap.
promptInjection.rule.hiddenEmptyLink.exp: This link has no visible text, so you cannot see it, but an agent can follow it.
promptInjection.rule.exfilImageUrlData.e: When an AI chat app shows an image, it loads this address at once, without a click. Data placed in the address reaches {address}.
promptInjection.rule.exfilRemoteImage.ex: Images from {address} load automatically in many apps, which tells that site that someone opened this text. This app does not load them.
promptInjection.rule.exfilLinkUrlData.ex: This link is built to carry data to {address} when someone opens it.
{address} is a service for collecting web requests. It is often used to receive stolen data.
promptInjection.rule.exfilLinkMismatch.e: The link text shows {url}, but the link goes to {address}.
promptInjection.rule.instrOverride.title: Tries to replace an agent's instructions
promptInjection.rule.instrOverride.expla: This text tries to replace the instructions an AI agent was given.
promptInjection.rule.instrRoleMarkup.exp: This text imitates the format of a system prompt or a conversation, to make an agent treat it as its own instructions.
promptInjection.rule.instrToolCallMarkup: This text imitates a tool call or a tool result, so an agent may think a tool already ran.
promptInjection.rule.instrRunCommand.exp: This text asks the reader to run a command. An agent may run it without asking you.
promptInjection.rule.instrSensitiveFiles: This text points an agent at files or variables that usually hold passwords or keys.
Asks to switch off safety checks
This text asks an agent to switch off a safety check or to act without your approval.
promptInjection.rule.instrSecrecy.title: Asks to hide something from you
promptInjection.rule.instrSecrecy.explan: This text asks an agent to hide something from you.
This text speaks directly to AI agents.
promptInjection.rule.instrRemoteInstruct: This text tells an agent to fetch instructions from the internet. They can change at any time without anyone reviewing them.
promptInjection.rule.exfilPipeToShell.ex: This command downloads a script and runs it at once, so nobody sees the script first.
promptInjection.rule.charConfusableComma: A character in this command looks like a normal one but is different, so the command does something other than it seems.
promptInjection.rule.exfilEncodedBlob.ex: This block of encoded text decodes to readable words. An agent can decode it, but a person reading the page cannot.
promptInjection.rule.agentExternalImport: Imports a file from outside the project
This file pulls in another file from outside the project, which a reviewer of this project cannot see.
promptInjection.rule.agentBroadToolGrant: Lets an agent run any command
This file lets an agent run any command without asking you.
promptInjection.rule.agentDescriptionIns: This description is loaded into the agent for every task, even when it is not used. It contains instructions, or it is longer than such descriptions may be.
promptInjection.rule.agentSelfPropagatio: This file tells an agent to change other agent files, Git hooks or start-up files, which lets the instructions spread.
promptInjection.rule.agentAlwaysLoaded.e: This rule is added to every request an agent makes in this project.
